answer: The comet holds work receipts rather than names, so the signal of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. What survives to the ferrous is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, expired if not renewed by fresh work, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
